controls.name: five values agree with independent PDF/workbook reference
native acquisition, exact original bytes and fixed semantics
changed bytes cannot become static fallback

native.population: Adult social care overall ratings published under the single assessment framework as at 1 August 2025.
native.assessment_unit: Ratings of individual adult social care services at a location; not unique locations, providers or patients.
native.adjustment: Published integer counts; not seasonally adjusted.
native.period_convention: Historical snapshot as at 1 August 2025; not a current whole-England service census.
native.revision_policy: Fixed original PDF bytes as well as historical edition and snapshot. Every count is structurally extracted from the fetched original; any changed PDF bytes require new independent evidence and reviewed acceptance. No automatic revision or future-edition substitution.
native.limitations: Assessment was prioritised by risk and this cohort is unlikely to represent all adult social care services. Single-framework service-level ratings must not be combined with or compared with previous-framework location ratings or previous years. No whole-England quality rate, trend, care capacity, patient outcome or individual-provider recommendation is supported. The total overlaps the four categories and must not be added to them.
